articles.title: Bitmine’s ETH buying slows as Tom Lee's firm shifts capital to share buybacks
articles.snippet: Chairman Tom Lee said easing financial conditions could support crypto, even as the CLARITY Act failed to reach a Senate vote before the August recess.

articles.title: Live updates: WTI crude oil up 5% and back to $80, as bitcoin drops below $64,000
articles.snippet: The market rose even as the Senate left the crypto bill unpassed before its recess, with steady ETF inflows and a softer dollar doing more for prices than Washington.

articles.title: Is Clarity's delay a blessing in disguise?: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The crypto industry is angry and disappointed that the Senate is not holding a procedural vote on the Clarity Act this month, but that isn't the worst possible outcome.

articles.title: ‘Disappointing’ — crypto advocates react to delay in CLARITY vote
articles.snippet: Following a procedural delay in the US Senate, lawmakers are expected to address a major crypto market structure bill after they return from a month-long recess, which met with industry criticism.

articles.title: BIP-110 ends with a whimper, CLARITY vote punted: Hodler’s Digest, Aug. 9
articles.snippet: BIP-110 forks itself into oblivion with a “2-block chain” and CLARITY will finally get a Senate vote in September. The odds say that vote will be a No.
